skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Heavenly Mirage
skins.content: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Heavenly Mirage. Recreation of a Lungmen VIP's childhood fantasy. She enters the Xians' abode, dressed in celestial garb, skirts dark as kohl, jade pure as ice, face austere, serene. Transcendent.
skins.quote: My gaze falls upon clearest ice and coldest jade, arrayed hither and tither. The Qionghua blooms of the celestial realm know my heart, and refuse to wither. —Inscribed in Lin Yühsia's study

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA137
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA137. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.quote: 'Lin the Violet' handles her accounts, while 'Fins the Colorful' swim about in circles. You and I are neither Lin nor Fin, so how can we know of what joy and pain lie within?
